channel.title: CIS 532 - Introduction to Deep Learning :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Course Description Foundations of deep learning, with focus on different types of modern neural network architectures (such as convolutional neural networks, recurrent neural networks, and transformers). Regularization and optimization in the context of deep learning. Frameworks and tools for building and training deep neural networks.
